parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description:
The streaming domain.

> - Make sure that the specified domain name is a streaming domain and that you have the required permissions to operate on it.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time. The time must be later than the start time. The format is *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ssZ* (UTC).

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time. The format is *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ssZ* (UTC).
